requirements.title: Frozen coherent origin composition
requirements.criterion: A selected origin binds one coherent world/history/body/life/means state before live publication.
proposedExpansion: Author a compatibility graph rather than a free Cartesian product: each route declares which layers it keeps, creates, replaces or leaves unknown.
Separate definition, continuity, era, instance, visit, body, controlled actor and life identity; validate every actor/location/custody reference.
Keep known starting means separate from hidden candidate truth; conflicts name the failed causal support and a possible divergent route.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: chooseSimulationOrigin in src/simulation.js is a once-only claim/effects plan. createWorldInstance in src/world_instances.js binds IDs and initial facts but does not initialize all native character owners. Missing atomic origin initializer and typed cross-owner binding contract.
acceptanceCases: Invalid world/era/body combination fails without any live edits.
A valid snapshot supplies legal first actions without Frontier enrollment.
Retry after failed durable publication uses the same pending selected result.
remaining: Integrator must select state owners and durable transaction host; full initializer is absent from inspected consumers.

requirements.title: Suspenseful random entry and exact result retention
requirements.criterion: An eligible random result is committed once and revealed only through the active character’s available means.
proposedExpansion: Pool records revision, pack availability, eligible snapshot IDs, weights or selection rule and reasons for exclusions in an author-only owner.
Random default, optional configuration, later discovered entries and prior-life planned entry are distinct modes. No mandatory chooser reveals the catalog.
Freeze selected snapshot and any family/body/private rolls before live publication; only an explicit local reroll mechanism creates another selection cause.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: No runtime caller of chooseSimulationOrigin was found outside tests/simulation.test.js. Missing native new-game entry host and pending-selection persistence decision.
acceptanceCases: Opening menus or previewing never rerolls.
Save/reload/import preserves the result and first-action state.
Candidate unavailable before commitment follows declared fallback; removed pack after commitment remains dormant or follows reviewed migration, without a free reroll.
remaining: Exact seed/weights/reroll/fallback policies remain local proposals.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Historical early, mid-event and late snapshots
requirements.criterion: Each selected historical start has era-appropriate actors, stock, institutions and usable actions.
proposedExpansion: Before an event: its actual causes, preparation routes and unaware observers exist. During it: interruptions, commitments, routes and urgent actions are already situated. After it: changed possession, absences, recovery and succession remain real.
Separate pre-entry world causes from player-earned history: adult experience may be authored background with provenance, never invented completed player actions.
Use source-qualified baselines plus meaningful deltas; late starting stock cannot replenish an already consumed unique object.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/world_instances.js accepts eraId but constructor reads one definition.initialFacts and initial sites. Missing snapshot materializer for native actors, inventories, access, commitments and knowledge.
acceptanceCases: Early start lacks unearned late offices and training.
Mid-event first action can change an actual pending cause.
Late snapshot does not resurrect a missing participant or reset unique claims.
remaining: World owners must verify exact local chronology/cast; no new book audit performed.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Ordinary adult, outsider and established late life
requirements.criterion: Starting age and history change actual means, legal actions and connected pursuits.
proposedExpansion: New local adult: familiar language/customs with specific work, lodging and contacts; outsider: actual cargo, language gap and route to shelter or communication.

Retired soldier, elder, craft veteran and displaced professional variants keep bodily condition, particular knowledge and social history distinct. Advanced age is not a universal weakness and experience is not an automatic skill grant.

Immediate choices include local work, applying a retained method, contacting an acquaintance, seeking language aid or refusing old expectations; develop mentoring, repair, investigation and institution influence.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/character_creation.js writes bio.age and other cosmetics; it does not materialize authored careers, native skills or age physiology. Existing native activities can be reused only after snapshot access is bound.
acceptanceCases: Two different age/history snapshots yield different working first actions.
Authored background marks its provenance rather than earned gameplay.
A veteran can use a genuinely retained supported faculty immediately.
remaining: Select finite backgrounds and body policy per world.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Generated household with independent people
requirements.criterion: A generated family has durable people, actual relationships, care and property owners.
proposedExpansion: Freeze members, age/stage, relations, residence, language, occupation, time/care means and public/private history from local templates. Include supportive poverty, restrictive wealth, communal care, foster/adoptive and isolated adult variants where coherent.
Each family member has an independent goal and known facts, not automatic loyalty or omniscient recognition. Household resources do not become player inventory through family membership.
Immediate requests, shared work, observation, refusals and trust lead to access, lessons, family disagreement, migration or independence; later members can leave, prosper or create new obligations.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/simulation.js and effect owners contain person/knowledge/relationship machinery; no selected deterministic family generator or native household initializer was identified. G3 owns subsequent family activity.
acceptanceCases: Reload retains the same family members and holdings.
Loaned tool remains one object with actual custody.
A caregiver responds to demonstrated evidence without reading private memories.
remaining: Template coverage, genealogy generation and bounded NPC advancement need selected contracts.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Infant agency and supported care
requirements.criterion: An infant origin has useful limited-body actions and an explicit source of support.
proposedExpansion: Observation, attention, recall, signaling and supported motor control use actual senses/body faculties; no adult speech or dexterity appears solely from old memories.

A first recognized signal, retained sensory association or deliberate choice of attention yields a real relationship/knowledge change. Care can be actual funded NPC activity or clearly bounded authored abstraction.

Offer quiet, unsafe and exceptional starts with honest agency; no automatic perfect caregiver, universal offline death or guaranteed rescue. Unusual faculties may bypass physical limits if they truly grant that function.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing native menus and combat assume the controlled adult actor. Missing age/body action legality, infant communication target and care-state consumer.
acceptanceCases: Signal attempt produces only effects supported by body and observer.
An immediate useful action exists without waiting real-time years.
Caregiver unavailable follows chosen support policy, without silently creating a caretaker.
remaining: Selected finite care/communication mechanics and optional danger terms remain open.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Child, adolescent and compressed development
requirements.criterion: Meaningful childhood choices and a declared chapter advance change body, knowledge and world state coherently.
proposedExpansion: Chores, literacy, movement, friendship, supervised experiment and apprenticeship become usable through local means, not a universal birthday level gate.
Chapter advance declares elapsed local/traveler time, unfinished jobs, care, participating actors, study outcomes, property, obligations and risks before commitment.
Retain chosen habits and taught knowledge; stage transitions may open autonomy, school access, leadership or a changed body without granting every unseen canon event.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Missing chapter projector that reconciles native jobs/character, actor development and selected timeline scope through existing durable command authority. Biography is not an event simulator.
acceptanceCases: A taught method survives a chapter jump but unsupported mastery does not appear.
Outstanding borrowed property and commitments remain accounted for.
Reload of the chapter result cannot grant another advance or reward.
remaining: World-local ages and abstraction scope must be selected; no physiological schedule asserted.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Memory, language and amnesia are separate domains
requirements.criterion: Starting recollections, trained execution, language and unknown past remain separately represented.
proposedExpansion: Native memory, previous-life memory, source-reader recollection, partial amnesia and total amnesia are meaningful variants. Preserved physical skill can be usable while unnamed only if its actual faculty remains.
Claims from recollection are leads with provenance; source history may already differ. Recall of a method is distinct from source/body/fuel/mastery necessary to execute it.
NPC recognition and existing property can expose an amnesiac’s past through letters, witnessed behavior or contacts; no automatic author notebook identifies hidden origin.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing simulation knowledge/source/faculty owners support portions; no origin-domain mapping for implicit native abilities and language was found. src/life_record.js is a lossy biography, not knowledge authority.
acceptanceCases: Old plot memory does not certify current branch outcomes.
Amnesiac can use a retained supported action without revealing an unobserved explanation.
Forgotten language and remembered written notes differ in communication access.
remaining: Local knowledge labels, imperfect memory rules and native UI projections need selected integration.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Body capability, needs and legal native actions
requirements.criterion: Body anatomy, senses, channels and needs drive real action and stat consumers.
proposedExpansion: Author direct verbs, senses, functional supports, production, communication, exposure/time and ending/transition behavior; use extensible capabilities rather than fixed universal slots.

Represent organic, bio-synthetic, cyborg, full construct, plant, spirit and exceptional no-need bodies with their real requirements. Cheats that remove hunger or maintenance actually remove the relevant obligation.

Translate work, learning, social contact, crafting, exploration and conflict through direct means, helpers or real acquired adapters. Missing ability is not justification to expose a secret unlock hint.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/body_progression.js implements hand conditions/training for the existing human. src/models/person.js has configurable stat bonus methods; src/config.js disables racial and height bonuses. Missing general body legality/needs binding and selected native recovery/combat consumers.
acceptanceCases: An actor without hands cannot equip a human tool absent an actual adapter.
A full robot does not require ordinary food solely because upstream rest/food exists.
A supported exceptional body retains superior stats without imposed symmetric tradeoffs.
remaining: One representative native action adapter must qualify before batching body families.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Species, genetics, constitution and physical identity
requirements.criterion: Each selected personal layer has its own provenance and actual declared function.
proposedExpansion: Keep species, genetic heredity, constitution, lineage, aptitude, senses, build, sex, presentation and name distinct; a world need not use every layer or reveal them at creation.

Fantasy genes can use local simplified rules or non-genetic inheritance; do not make two-copy dominance or mutation a universal cosmological rule. Adoption changes family and custody, not necessarily anatomy.

Physique can affect processes and healing, aptitude learning, lineage an actual faculty; dormant state differs from control and ancestry rumor. Cosmetic texture may remain texture where no causal use exists.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing race bonus methods could apply selected stats but global enabling would change old saves; missing world/body-scoped effective stat derivation and local inheritance contract.
acceptanceCases: Changing a body recalculates the owned body contribution once.
A false lineage reading changes belief without rewriting genotype or faculties.
A adopted child gains real family ties without automatically receiving bodily lineage.
remaining: Exact inheritance and stat contribution are local choices; no universal fairness/caps required.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Source role, counterpart and predecessor faculties
requirements.criterion: Role, actual body, learned technique, source, equipment and legitimate authority are independently initialized.
proposedExpansion: Role-only counterpart, actual retained-body replacement, full inherited-function premise, shared inhabitant and altered-body divergence remain available when coherent.
A genuinely retained organ/faculty keeps its declared function; no invented cost or weakness is mandatory to permit it. No-power mode explicitly names removed domains.
Recognition can create expectations, assistance, investigation or hostility through actual witnesses; possessing a face or office label need not convey passwords, institutional acceptance or custody.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: chooseSimulationOrigin can apply declared effects but does not move all native body/source/office owners or resolve multiple consciousnesses. Missing route-specific transfer/identity initializer.
acceptanceCases: Role-only actor lacks a method but may seek teaching or buy help.
Actual operative inherited faculty works immediately when advertised.
A person who never met the predecessor cannot automatically recognize replacement.
remaining: Exact source-role canon and private pack content require later world-qualified source work.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Arrival routes, sponsors and paid/free access
requirements.criterion: Every identified route has a local cause, initiator, carrier, entry result and interruption behavior.
proposedExpansion: Retain walk/portal, summon, invitation, assigned drop, reincarnation, host arrival, shared possession, projection, lineage anchor, passenger, smuggling, summon interception, ritual/dream/death passage, forced scenario and world collision/integration.

Constructed/bought pocket worlds need actual ownership and viable initial environment; buying a ticket is distinct from reaching a usable endpoint. Sponsors may supply terms, cover identity, cargo or none.

Paid currencies, collateral, service, fuel, coordinates, information and free access are route variants, not universal entry taxes. Taking entry away from its requester may have concrete local aftermath.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/world_instances.js createWorldVisit records already-authorized arrival and grants no passage. Missing selected route consumer binding actor/body/cargo/entry snapshot before visit publication.
acceptanceCases: An authorized passenger retains separate custody from the main traveler.
Failed summon cannot publish a half-created origin.
Free passage works without invented payment where the selected rule grants it.
remaining: Each world chooses permissible routes; source’s method is not automatically available to every actor.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Means, poverty, custody and initial reachability
requirements.criterion: A start’s claimed resources, access and first actions correspond to actual held means.
proposedExpansion: Initial body, cash, owned/borrowed gear, household permission, shelter, food or alternative support, documents, services and contacts each name holder and provenance.
Zero resources, extreme wealth and overwhelming retained powers remain coherent variants; they do not need balanced opening rewards. A sealed strong start can still expose only observed means.

First-action qualification checks a meaningful pursuit, interruption/refusal, needed support and an actual development route; an intentionally lethal/no-agency origin requires explicit selected terms, not accidental softlock.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing native inventory, money, simulation resources and custody are multiple domains. Missing origin transaction reconciles them without duplicating household stock or loans.
acceptanceCases: A wealthy family does not duplicate its entire stock into the child inventory.
Known inaccessible route explains known impediment without exposing unknown destination.
A powerful starting means solves its suitable obstacle directly.
remaining: Select opening stock and support for each candidate; no new global starter kit.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Monster, beast and familiar lives
requirements.criterion: Creature anatomy, communication and independence produce distinct playable actions.
proposedExpansion: Monster: hunt/hide/negotiate/territory and optional evolution; beast: forage/scout/guard/social pack; familiar: bond, terms, actual owner/partner and possible independence.
Human society response follows observed form, local laws and particular goals, not global hostility or universal lack of rights. A capable creature can craft or talk directly if supported.
Early useful action can sense shelter, choose a target, signal a keeper or fulfill/refuse a request; development connects diet/body, brood, cooperation, institutions and changed form.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: No selected creature-origin native consumer identified; reuse encounter/action machinery after sensory, inventory, body and control adapters qualify.
acceptanceCases: A familiar refuses a command if its selected agency permits.
Evolution changes real functions and retention, not only race label.
A creature that can speak negotiates through that real channel.
remaining: Local species/rights/evolution source questions remain with world owners.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Plant and fungus-network lives
requirements.criterion: Rooted and distributed plant bodies have real perception, production and reach.
proposedExpansion: Seed, egg-like dormant phase, sapling, mature tree and linked fungus network starts differ in supported senses, roots/nodes and actual useful actions.
Water/light/soil may be relevant support, while magical/perpetual variants follow their actual exceptions. No hearing every conversation without hearing or another real channel.

Tending relationships, selective supported outputs, grafting, shelter, habitat commerce, seed dispersal and transplant can connect to village, grove, mobile avatar or object-body transition. Each node/seed defines consciousness and source retention.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Origins owner explicitly lacks nonhuman native adapters; bodyProgression is human-specific. Missing rooted reach/senses and legitimate production/ownership consumer.
acceptanceCases: Root-bound body cannot walk on human location controls.
Signal is readable only by a person holding its interpretation means.
Seed offspring does not duplicate parent consciousness unless its mechanism permits.
remaining: Selected public generic proof can be authored without disclosing sealed world truths.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Object, artifact, ship and vehicle lives
requirements.criterion: A conscious object has custody, supported senses and action authority distinct from its holder.
proposedExpansion: Sword/ring/tool, relic, broken artifact, vehicle/ship and crewed mobile body are distinct variants. Being owned, being controlled and consenting to cooperate are different relations.
Immediate actions can affect a genuinely supported function, refuse an offered use, sense contact, communicate a pattern or maintain a component; not every object is immobile.
Reforging, upgrades, new wielders, theft, display, burial, crew replacement, navigation and later embodiment preserve particular history and actual parts.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native equipment treats objects as inventory, not controlled actor entities. Missing identity binding between actor and unique physical item/vehicle and holder-mediated command host.
acceptanceCases: Trading the object changes custody once while retaining its actor memory.
Holder cannot wield an object’s independent faculty without its required authority.
Vehicle movement carries actual crew/cargo and consumes only its local declared support.
remaining: Resolve inventory/actor dual reference with G5 before implementation.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Spirit, undead, divine and demonic lives
requirements.criterion: Nonordinary bodies use their actual manifestation, needs and survival rules.
proposedExpansion: Spirit/ghost, undead, divine being and demon are separate families; belief, anchor, blood, mana, worship, ordinary food or no need depend on selected source.
Immediate observation, whisper, manifestation, contractual aid, haunting or embodied action follows actual interaction reach; material intangibility does not imply omniscience.
Growth through anchors, rites, body reconstruction, communities, domains, revival, law or negotiation has defined source/body retention; superior or immortal forms retain actual strength.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Missing selected immaterial targeting/manifestation and body-specific recovery consumer; native human defeat must remain compatible.
acceptanceCases: Material obstacle matters only where the selected faculty interacts with it.
Revival follows the actual surviving carrier and cannot be inferred from a biography.
Divine start has no compulsory worship resource when the local rule grants inherent power.
remaining: Each family needs local source qualification; generic genre descriptions are proposals.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Construct, golem, cyborg and bio-synthetic lives
requirements.criterion: Manufactured and hybrid bodies have component-specific support and repair.
proposedExpansion: Full machine, animated golem, homunculus, cyborg and bio-synthetic bodies keep biological needs, power, binding and stabilizers separate. Perpetual core and self-repair variants remain possible.
First action may self-diagnose, request authorized maintenance, use a functional attachment, compute or refuse creator orders. Ownership and repair supplier dependency are distinct.
Components, programs, self-modification, freedom, replacement chassis and source transfer change actual capabilities and custody; installing a device is not automatic mind duplication.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native food/rest/gear consumers need selected body binding. Existing repair/equipment structures are possible reuse, not inspected proof of complete construct origins.
acceptanceCases: Machine restoration repairs the damaged component without human rest-only healing.
Replacing a part loses only its supported functions.
Free/self-sufficient body acts without invented recurring upkeep.
remaining: Specific repair functions/parts and issuer authority require a qualified packet.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Place, dungeon, house, river and array lives
requirements.criterion: A place-body can act through supported sites, residents and channels.
proposedExpansion: Dungeon, house, river/lake, protective array and sanctuary differ in extent, controllable structures, visitors and real support.
Immediate actions can change one supported feature, route a real resource, signal an occupant, offer shelter or inspect a sensor; no automatic ability to create stock or control people.

Renovation, rooms, traps, hydrology, sect protection, trade, family generations and territorial expansion connect to existing places and claims. Site-body destruction/relocation must declare surviving core or substrate.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: World sites currently represent locations/facts, not full controlled body authority. Missing actor-to-place extent, native site commands and distinct resident consent ownership.
acceptanceCases: Changing a room affects actual route/access or declared use.
Residents retain independent aims and property.
Moving a core changes only the body scope that its actual mechanism carries.
remaining: Selected extent/performance boundary and site actor binding need G5 review.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Collective, symbiont, parasite and shared-body lives
requirements.criterion: Distributed or shared embodiment has explicit control, information and loss boundaries.
proposedExpansion: Hive/swarm, multiple equal nodes, queen/core, symbiont, parasite and second soul variants state where mind resides, how messages travel and who commands each action.
A host can refuse a proposal, consent to cooperation or contest control according to the local mechanism; extraordinary total control may exist when truly provided.
Node loss, split, reunion, host change and removal preserve actual memory/source/custody under declared scope; a living host is a person and map of means, not just a hit-point container.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing simulation actor/controller structures give useful primitives, but no generic multiple-controller-to-one-native-body arbitration inspected. Missing controlled body/action ownership and information-channel adapter.
acceptanceCases: Two nodes do not spend the same held item twice.
Host refusal prevents effects unless an actual override function succeeds.
An isolated node lacks updates it cannot receive.
remaining: Choose finite control/channel model before concurrent-body gameplay.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: System, guide, lineage and fate perspectives
requirements.criterion: The selected player perspective owns only the verbs and knowledge its actual role grants.
proposedExpansion: Character, soul, guide, system, lineage focus and fate/storyteller perspectives remain separate possibilities; no one mode becomes compulsory.
System first play can offer a supported quest, grant a genuinely backed reward, advise, trade or observe its host. The host acts independently unless a real takeover faculty grants more.

Source identity, trust, authority, reward backing, observers, host death, replacement and evolution tie to G2 mechanics and G3 people; no mandatory influence resource, host dependence or growth limit is imposed.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Native UI controls the main character. Missing selected system-as-controlled-actor native command and host outcome publication; controller primitives do not establish playable system role.
acceptanceCases: Host can refuse an ordinary offer.
Reward consumes backing only if the source actually requires backing.
Guide view does not expose hidden host facts beyond its own means.
remaining: Accepted system-entity possibility is preserved; actual local role protocol remains proposed.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Concept, rumor, weather, shadow and micro-scale lives
requirements.criterion: Abstract and micro-scale forms specify a concrete substrate, reach and useful verbs.
proposedExpansion: Story/song/rumor, disease/microbe, storm/element, reflection/shadow and national fortune are distinct proposed forms, not cosmetic races.
First actions can alter a supported transmission, manifestation, pattern, host-local contact or fate effect. Spread, mutation and forgetting only exist if the chosen mechanism uses them.
Cross scale through actual observed channels: a microscopic life cannot inspect the world map; a rumor may learn through retelling; a shadow may act independently only if it gains that faculty.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Missing selected substrate/reach model and native commands. Do not build general physical simulation; author one finite causal consumer preserving its promised scope.
acceptanceCases: Form acts on a real target in its supported scale.
Retelling changes a rumor only through an actual participant/channel.
Destroyed substrate follows selected persistence, without universal auto-death or immortality.
remaining: Low-priority distinct adapter family retained; no source canon asserted.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Legacy, successor and unrelated next lives
requirements.criterion: A next life receives only what actually survives and is transferred through its valid link.
proposedExpansion: Child, apprentice, adopted ward, spouse, stranger, reincarnation, counterpart, companion and unrelated life retain different body, wishes, knowledge and obligations.
Will, letters, cache, taught method, institution, debt, inherited property and family reputation each use their actual owner and local recognition route. Unprepared destruction can leave nothing.

Successors and followers may refuse, leave, compete, betray or remain for their own reasons; no loyalty copy or full ancestor inventory clone. G1 owns entry snapshot; G4 owns actual ending transition.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/life_record.js is explicitly lossy/non-authoritative. Missing selected next-life control transfer and inheritance materializer joining persistent actors, custody and local law.
acceptanceCases: Destroyed legacy is absent from heir holdings.
Refusing an inheritance is a meaningful valid route where local law permits.
NPC’s loyalty remains their own saved relation, not ancestor player status.
remaining: Local inheritance law, refusal, source/body retention and selected ending gate require reconciliation.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Planned resurrection and constrained next-entry randomness
requirements.criterion: Surviving valid plans narrow or replace only the origin domains they actually control.
proposedExpansion: Heir designation, soul anchor, ritual, phylactery, backup body, seal, clone/fragment, patron pact, letters and trained successor remain separate plans.
Full control, narrowed pool, weighted nudge and no control are distinct valid mechanisms. No global rising-cost ladder is required; a perfect free plan works if its source promises it.
Moving/breaking/stealing a carrier, refusal, elapsed era, patron changes and partial plans produce actual supported consequences. A plan may choose body but leave place/time random.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Missing origin selection eligibility derived from actual surviving plans and ending receipts. Do not infer revival from saved narrative or reuse origin.selected as a per-life claim.
acceptanceCases: Exact functioning plan overrides only named random dimensions.
Broken plan is excluded for its actual cause without fake universal penalty.
Failed durable next-life publication retains original life and pending selection consistently.
remaining: Select one plan and finite transition proof first.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Immortal self with a new local beginning
requirements.criterion: A second beginning states what remains of the first self and how the two communicate or transfer.
proposedExpansion: In-person travel retains the actual body; projection/clone, soul fragment, sealed-body departure, possession and voluntary suppressed start are distinct. Immortality does not require a restart or loss of strength.
Strong full-power arrival, weaker created avatar, local fresh fragment and chosen locked power all remain possible; world-source interactions determine effects, not universal equalization.
Home self’s presence/absence, independent projects, rescue calls and resources remain real; exchanges require carriers and shared item/authority ownership, not cross-body duplication.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: world instance/visit primitives distinguish presence; no selected simultaneous native controlled-body initializer inspected. Missing body focus transfer and cross-body holdings protocol.
acceptanceCases: Home and local body do not accidentally share one native health/equipment object.
Full-power compatible arrival stays powerful.
Switching focus does not advance world clocks twice or reroll a beginning.
remaining: Cross-lane identity/time ownership is prerequisite; no mandatory weakness.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Parallel-history and replay-self starts
requirements.criterion: Premise start, successor, replay-self history and actual regression remain mechanically distinct.
proposedExpansion: Branch premise materializes its authored changed history; successor resumes lived aftermath; replay-self contains a separately controlled counterpart with declared retained receipts; regression performs G2/G4’s actual rollback.
Similar name/body/date does not merge actor identity or custody. Older player records are not enough to fabricate exact past-self actions absent authoritative receipts.
First encounters and recognition follow actual means and local policy; branch entry cannot reveal author-only future differences in a public chooser.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: createWorldInstance accepts parentInstanceId as metadata only. Missing snapshot/actor remapping and replay policy; src/life_record.js cannot recreate full history.
acceptanceCases: Two counterparts hold distinct local items unless transfer occurs.
Historical start does not silently roll back the existing save.
Replay-self behaves only within its declared receipt/model fidelity.
remaining: G4 owns history fidelity and G5 owns isolation contracts.

requirements.title: Start reveal, onboarding and recovery presentation
requirements.criterion: Opening UI communicates usable actions and known state without exposing candidate truths.
proposedExpansion: Begin with present sensory situation, active body/control and meaningful actions. World identity, era, family motives, latent traits and special rules arrive only through discovery.

Known resources/support, cancel/refusal/recovery and where information is unavailable are readable in existing panels. Do not show grey future verbs that reveal a sealed power or predetermined outcome.
Name, pronouns, language and body-directed text adapt to controlled perspective; first-use prompts are optional and explain actual support rather than author mechanics.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: src/character_creation.js is one upstream creation panel and does not consume world-scoped hidden-start projections. Missing start presentation adapter over native center/UI.
acceptanceCases: Low-information start still has a usable meaningful button.
Limited-body text never claims human sight/speech unsupported by its senses.
Unavailable pack/invalid candidate offers explicit recovery without revealing catalog.
remaining: Reviewer must check suspense/clarity with representative body and failure states.
requirements.authority: Proposal implementing requested start coverage; world-local rules and exact variants remain unselected

requirements.title: Source-specific candidate qualification and private content
requirements.criterion: Book/anime start candidates freeze source boundaries and label canon, interpretation and divergence.
proposedExpansion: Existing household/child/outsider/role/tree candidate variants are reusable local study, not fully verified direct adaptation. Exact era/cast/admission/faculty questions stay source tasks.
Record book/manga/anime versions separately; a companion synopsis cannot establish entire-source coverage. Original nonhuman metaphysics remain proposals where unsupported.

World GM must locate relevant evidence and author private direct-recreation pack content while public infrastructure remains generic; candidate truth stays sealed independently of private-pack placement.
requirements.engineConsumerOrGap: Existing candidate brief explicitly has no registered destination/initializer. Public source ledger is bounded companion evidence, not full seven-book read.
